title: Disappointing
text:
I gave it to my husband for christmas. First bag was great, basic beef jerky, second bag had a majority of unpalatable jerky and ended up getting tossed, third bag was basic beef jerky.
For the price of this subscription you'd expect more than basic beef jerky "seasoned" with sauces. And some of the combinations were so nasty in texture and flavor he couldn't eat them.
label: negative
